commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-prequal.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="472face97b21aa4e3f838a424d8245b3dee45b17"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "MAIN_SHA|$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
make test-ipo
echo "IPO_CPP_B5|PASS"
if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -x web/node_modules/.bin/vitest; then
  pnpm --dir web exec vitest run src/domain/ipo-board-readiness.test.ts
  echo "IPO_VITEST_B5|PASS"
else
  echo "IPO_VITEST_B5|BLOCKED_MISSING_LOCAL_DEPENDENCIES"
fi
git diff --quiet && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "WORKTREE_CLEAN|PASS"
